name: Cascade
description: The quintessential American hop. Bold grapefruit and citrus aroma. Cornerstone of American Pale Ales and IPAs.

name: Centennial
description: High-alpha American hop with floral and citrus character. Often called 'Super Cascade'. Great in IPAs.

name: Chinook
description: High bittering hop with bold pine and grapefruit notes. Excellent for West Coast IPAs and Pale Ales.

name: Columbus (CTZ)
description: High-alpha bittering hop. Dank, resinous character. Used in IPAs and American Stouts.

name: Citra
description: Intensely aromatic. Tropical fruit explosion — passion fruit, lime, and melon. Essential for hazy IPAs.

name: Simcoe
description: Complex hop with catty, tropical, and piney notes. Widely used in American IPAs and Pale Ales.

name: Mosaic
description: Versatile and complex. Blueberry, tropical fruit, and subtle earthiness. Excellent in hazy and West Coast IPAs.

name: Amarillo
description: Fruity and floral with prominent orange and stone fruit notes. Great late hop for IPAs and Pale Ales.

name: Galaxy
description: Australian high-alpha hop. Intense passion fruit and peach aroma. Excellent in hazy IPAs and Pale Ales.

name: Nelson Sauvin
description: Unique 'green grape' character with white wine and gooseberry notes. Distinctive in IPAs and Pale Ales.

name: Hallertau Mittelfrueh
description: Classic German noble hop. Mild, herbal, and floral. The traditional choice for Helles, Märzen, and Weizen.

name: Saaz
description: The classic Bohemian noble hop. Earthy, herbal, and mildly spicy. Essential for Pilsner Urquell-style Bohemian Pilsners.

name: Tettnang
description: German noble hop. Mild, pleasant herbal and floral character. Versatile in German lagers and ales.

name: Spalt
description: Mild German hop with spicy herbal notes. Traditional for Altbier and Kölsch.

name: Perle
description: Clean bittering hop with mild herbal character. Commonly used in German ales and lagers.

name: Magnum
description: Very clean bittering hop. High alpha, neutral flavor profile. Ideal for any style where you want clean bitterness.

name: Fuggle
description: Traditional English hop. Mild, earthy, and woody. Essential for British ales — ESBs, Porters, and Milds.

name: East Kent Goldings (EKG)
description: Classic English hop. Soft, smooth bitterness with honey and floral notes. Great in English Pale Ales and Bitters.

name: Challenger
description: Versatile British hop. Cedar and green tea notes. Used in English ales and strong bitters.

name: Northern Brewer
description: Clean bittering hop with mild pine character. Popular in traditional German and British ales.

name: Styrian Goldings
description: Slovenian Fuggle variant. Mild, earthy, and floral. Widely used in Belgian ales and British styles.

name: Willamette
description: American Fuggle variant. Mild and floral with subtle fruity notes. Versatile finishing hop.

name: Nugget
description: High-alpha bittering hop. Herbal, resinous character. Standard bittering hop in American ales.

name: Warrior
description: Very high alpha. Clean, smooth bitterness with minimal flavor contribution.

name: Summit
description: Ultra high-alpha hop. Citrus notes at low levels, catty at high levels. Best as bittering only.

name: Ekuanot
description: Extremely fruity and complex. Papaya, melon, and berry notes. Excellent in IPAs and Pale Ales.

name: El Dorado
description: Big, juicy tropical and stone fruit character. Watermelon and peach notes. Great in hazy IPAs.

name: Azacca
description: Bold tropical fruit character — mango and citrus dominant. Versatile in IPAs and Pale Ales.

name: Vic Secret
description: Australian hop with intense pine and tropical character. Passion fruit and subtle herbal notes.

name: Waimea
description: High-alpha New Zealand hop. Big tangerine and pine. Great dual-purpose hop for West Coast IPAs.

name: Motueka
description: Bright lime and lemon tropical notes. Elegant and refined. Excellent in Pale Ales and Lagers.

name: Riwaka
description: Intense grapefruit and tropical aroma. Expensive but highly aromatic. Excellent in single-hop IPAs.

name: Wakatu
description: Delicate floral and lime character. Soft and elegant. Great in Pilsners and Pale Ales.

name: Hallertau Blanc
description: German hop with New World character. White wine and tropical fruit notes. Excellent in Kölsch and wheat beers.

name: Huell Melon
description: Fruity German hop with melon and strawberry notes. Great in Hefeweizen and fruit-forward ales.

name: Calypso
description: Unique apple and pear character. Versatile dual-purpose hop for Pale Ales and IPAs.

name: Idaho 7
description: Complex and layered. Stone fruit with black tea undertones. Excellent in IPAs and Belgian-American hybrids.

name: Strata
description: Dank, complex hop. Distinctive green cannabis and tropical notes. Bold character in modern IPAs.

name: Loral
description: Elegant and complex. Floral and tropical with subtle dark fruit undertones. Excellent in Pale Ales and IPAs.

name: Talus
description: Intensely floral with rose and tropical fruit notes. Unique character in Pale Ales and IPAs.
